text: Managing a team effectively requires a balance of several key skills. First, clear communication is essential, as it ensures everyone understands their roles and the project’s goals. Equally important is delegation; a good leader trusts their team by assigning tasks that match each person’s strengths. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, helps team members improve and feel valued. To keep motivation high, it’s useful to celebrate small wins and recognize hard work. Finally, when conflicts arise, address them quickly and calmly. Listening to both sides and finding a fair solution prevents small disagreements from becoming bigger problems, fostering a more positive and productive environment for everyone.
